factor.name: seeded-initial-policy under fixed max9
factor.hypothesis: Explicitly retaining an already verified component winner can prevent rediscovery loss from stochastic Qwen responses while preserving the complete control and required four-stage work.
factor.causal_boundary: This is a queue/admission policy factor, not merely a free addition or an isolated causal hyperparameter ablation. It changes optional initial Qwen admission, feedback and possibly followup admission. Qwen has no supported deterministic seed; one matched A/B pair does not establish stable causal gain.

generic_infrastructure.default: Absent: prior behavior, default portfolio, controls, HPO and API/resource caps unchanged.
generic_infrastructure.path_and_schema: One <=32768-byte UTF-8 regular JSON file, no symlink/reparse ancestors, stable read identity/size, duplicate keys/nonfinite JSON rejected. Only supported SINGLE recipe fields. Unknown params/authority keys, ensembles, free feature code, nonnoop data policy, text/ranking and second selector rejected in V1. Existing normalize, signature, feature-view/target-smearing validators retained.
generic_infrastructure.feature_compatibility: Trusted generic_features modes preserved exactly; no forced broad/selection on champion. Explicit history and target-encoding groups must match available schema. Target-dependent checks and all fitting-scope guards remain in worker.
generic_infrastructure.preconditions: Explicit --four-stage --preserve-anchor --control-recipe; max_experiments>=9, >=2 planner calls and positive HPO trials. Invalid/missing champion aborts the opted-in whole experiment before the first model fit; no silent drop, control replacement or zero metric.
generic_infrastructure.authority: Recipe data cannot modify CLI, input paths, code, evaluators, budgets or control. Sidecar metadata is for root audit only and is never read as runtime authority.
generic_infrastructure.input_policy: Future coordinator copies exactly the pinned champion JSON bytes into candidate task cwd as champion_recipe_input.json; no metadata, rows, predictions or model state. Runtime records source SHA/bytes/signature, writes normalized champion_recipe.json snapshot, and protects both input and snapshot in provenance. No imports from candidate files. JSON is outside the table resolver csv/tsv/tab catalog.
generic_infrastructure.reusable_vs_local: No task ID, public feature name, label, baseline score or T5-specific filename exists in generic source. champion-t5-regression.json/lineage are separate local benchmark inputs.

queue_policy.dynamic_dedup: Champion duplicate of required seed receives explicit duplicate receipt, no extra fit; hypotheses and 5/5.0/noop policy do not create distinct signatures. Qwen duplicate champion is not fitted twice. Exact positions may advance when dedup reduces queue; none are evidence that actual stages completed.
queue_policy.tradeoff: With five required seeds and a distinct champion, a full initial queue admits one of two initial Qwen proposals; the second has not_scheduled_initial_capacity receipt. This replaces optional admission, not control/family/broad/HPO. Under shorter initial queues the remaining optional followup capacity can differ.
queue_policy.current_T6_observation: T6 initial EDA returned two parsed plans and both were admitted in initial slots5/6; its later planner-2 returned two plans but only the first ran at outer8 under max9. Proposed B instead reserves initial slot5 for champion and admits at most one initial Qwen plan at6. Do not confuse initial EDA with followup planner-2.
queue_policy.HPO_anchor: Always the unchanged protected SINGLE success record, never the prior champion or current best; sampler/seed/trials/budget unchanged.
queue_policy.execution_limit: Reservation of slots does not guarantee successful stages or sufficient wall time. Actual EDA-before-fit, selector success, families, HPO, selection/refit/CSV must pass independent future proof.
